bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo GAYBBS_IMAGE_STATUS_BEGIN
docker inspect -f 'RUNNING={{.State.Running}} IMAGE={{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format 'IMAGE_ID={{.Id}} OS={{.Os}} ARCH={{.Architecture}}'
echo GAYBBS_IMAGE_STATUS_END
echo GH_CLI_BEGIN
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GH_PRESENT; if gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo GH_AUTH_READY; else echo GH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE; fi; else echo GH_MISSING; fi
echo GH_CLI_END
echo GAYBBS_BUILD_BUNDLE_ARTIFACT
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test -f /app/gaybbs.mjs && sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs'
